faqs.question: What if my flight is delayed?
faqs.answer: We track your flight in real time. Your driver will adjust their arrival time automatically and wait at no extra cost.

faqs.question: Where does the driver meet me?
faqs.answer: The driver meets you at the arrivals hall with a name board. For T1–T4 and Jewel, we specify the exact meeting point in your booking confirmation.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.answer: We recommend booking at least 2 hours before your pickup, though same-day bookings are often available. WhatsApp us to check availability.

faqs.question: Can our company open a monthly billing account?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer 30-day corporate credit terms and itemized monthly statements for registered companies in Singapore.

faqs.question: Can you handle multiple executive pickups simultaneously?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our fleet coordination team manages multi-vehicle simultaneous arrivals and point-to-point transfers seamlessly.

faqs.question: Do drivers speak fluent English and follow corporate etiquette?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our corporate chauffeurs are fluent in English, discreet, professional, and knowledgeable about Singapore's business venues.

faqs.question: Can we decorate the bridal car beforehand?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can arrive early at your florist or location to have the vehicle beautifully dressed before the bride's departure.

faqs.question: Can the driver make multiple stops for photoshoots?
faqs.answer: With our hourly wedding packages, you have unlimited stops across Singapore (e.g. Marina Bay, Botanic Gardens, hotel).

faqs.question: How do we coordinate guest shuttle buses after the banquet?
faqs.answer: We provide dedicated dispatch coordination to run multiple return trips ensuring all your guests reach home comfortably.

faqs.question: Can you handle hundreds of attendees for a corporate conference?
faqs.answer: Yes, we deploy synchronized fleets of 13-seater minibuses and 7/9-seater maxi cabs to move large delegations efficiently.

faqs.question: Can we place event signage on the vehicles?
faqs.answer: Yes! Custom windshield signboards and event logos can be placed so your attendees easily spot their designated shuttle.

faqs.question: What if our concert or convention finishes later than planned?
faqs.answer: Our event dispatch team monitors schedule changes and keeps vehicles on standby to absorb event overtime smoothly.

faqs.question: Are ERP tolls and parking charges included in the hourly rate?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our transparent hourly rates cover ERP tolls, fuel, and standard waiting periods with no hidden surcharges.

faqs.question: Can I leave my personal belongings in the cab while shopping?
faqs.answer: Yes, your driver remains on standby with the vehicle locked and secured throughout your entire booking.

faqs.question: Can we extend the booking during the trip?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can simply notify your driver or WhatsApp dispatch to extend your hours as you go.

services.title: Wheelchair Accessible Transport
services.subtitle: Safe, Dignified Hospital & Home Mobility
services.shortDescription: Purpose-built accessible vehicles with hydraulic ramps, 4-point safety harness, and courteous assistance for wheelchair users.
services.heroDescription: Dignified, comfortable, and LTA-certified wheelchair accessible transport for hospital visits, dialysis appointments, family outings, and airport transfers.
inclusions: Certified heavy-duty hydraulic ramp & low-incline entry
4-point Q'Straint floor locking safety harness
Complimentary ramp boarding & alighting assistance
Capacity for 1–2 wheelchairs plus 4–7 accompanying family members
Door-to-door hospital, polyclinic, and nursing home pickups
Hospital return pickup coordination (driver waits or returns at discharge)
Spacious, climate-controlled cabin
Direct WhatsApp line for medical dispatch

faqs.question: Can the driver assist with moving the wheelchair user down the ramp?
faqs.answer: Yes, our drivers are patient, courteous, and trained to assist with boarding, securing the 4-point harness, and smooth alighting.

faqs.question: Can family members ride along in the same vehicle?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our wheelchair vans accommodate up to 2 wheelchair users PLUS 4 to 7 family members in comfortable regular seats.

faqs.question: How do hospital discharge return pickups work?
faqs.answer: You can book a 2-way trip with flexible return timing. Just message us 30 minutes before discharge, and your driver will be waiting.
